title: A Run Workflow whose boot step exhausts its retries still finalizes
description: Absorbed from yoh final-review finding 0c110874 (cs1, high). After cr4 gave the boot step a deliberate retry policy, a boot that exhausts its retries throws out of supervisePass and the run never reaches finalize: tokens are not revoked, the run row is never settled, the container sweep never runs. The Workflow's whole job after yoh is boot, budget, watch, retry, finalize - so a run that cannot finalize breaks yoh's definition of done.
acceptance_criteria: A boot that exhausts its retries ends in finalize (tokens revoked, run row settled with a reason naming the boot failure, containers swept); a vitest drives it; go and ts gates pass
